ASH & AETHER — CINEMATIC UPGRADE

Open review.html or play Ash_Aether_Cinematic_Cut.mp4.
73 seconds, 1280 x 720, 24 fps, stereo AAC. 22 edited shots across eight recovered chapters.

Added: motivated horizontal camera moves, cinematic framing, closer compositions, restrained grading, fades, editorial chapter captions, and an original synthesized ambient score with chime motifs and soft noise ambience. The orchard section uses the earlier ten-second generated animation. The other sections animate the camera over prepared artwork; they do not contain newly rigged body motion.

All captions are new editorial copy, not recovered dialogue. There is no voice acting or lip sync. This is a standalone cinematic concept cut and has not been installed into the game or the other session's project. Character design and narrative continuity still require reconciliation with the live game; source boards came from the previously recovered eight-mission snapshot.

Contents include edit_timeline.json, source boards in assets/, the original orchard pilot, and build_cinematic.py. To rebuild, install Python 3 with Pillow and NumPy, FFmpeg with libx264 and drawtext, and DejaVu Serif at the path used in the script. Run python3 build_cinematic.py. work/ is regenerated and intentionally excluded from the download.

Validation: final video is fully decoded with FFmpeg, metadata checked, and representative shot stills inspected. Continuous human review of movement and listening approval remain pending. Final polish should include shot-specific layered effects, carefully directed body performance, voice, and the character rigs maintained in the other session. No additional generative video credits were used for this edit.
